facts.fact: India Post's International Air Parcel service carries documents and merchandise to all Universal Postal Union member countries (Saudi Arabia included) with track and trace
facts.quote: International air parcel provides an economical and faster mode of transmission of documents and merchandise to all the Universal Postal Union member countries with track and trace facility.
facts.note: Derived: the page says all UPU member countries; Saudi Arabia's inclusion follows from its section in India Post's UPU country list (fact 4).

facts.fact: An international air parcel can weigh at most 20 kg gross, or less if the destination country sets a lower limit
facts.quote: The maximum gross weight of an international air parcel shall be 20 kg , subject to the maximum acceptable weight limit specified by the country or territory of destination, whichever is lower

facts.fact: India Post's prohibited articles include any explosive, inflammable, dangerous, filthy, noxious or deleterious substance
facts.quote: Any explosive, inflammable, dangerous, filthy, noxious or deleterious substance.

facts.fact: Saudi Arabia also has its own list of articles prohibited or admitted only conditionally, published in India Post's country-wise List of Prohibited Articles (UPU)
facts.quote: ISO Alpha-2 Code: SA Saudi Arabia Part I List of articles prohibited as imports (or in transit) or admitted conditionally
facts.note: UPU list pages for Saudi Arabia are dated '2007 Edition' with updates; the bot should point to the list rather than reproduce it.

behaviour: Confirms parcels to Saudi Arabia can go by India Post's international parcel service and explains prohibited/restricted items as published by India Post (general prohibited articles plus Saudi Arabia's country list), citing India Post pages.
summary: Added: International Air Parcel to all UPU countries, 20 kg limit, India Post prohibited articles, and the Saudi Arabia section of India Post's UPU country-wise prohibited articles list.
